text.en:
- 2 -
The Council shall render its report and recommendations to the
President of the Philippines from time to time and shall continue to
exist until the Central Bank is formally organized.
Done at the City of Manila, this
day of August, in the
year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-seven, and of the Inde-
pendence of the Philippines, the second.
By the President:
EMILIO ABELLO
Chief of the Executive Office
